newsitem.title: USA: Diamond Offshore buys vessel for $81 mln.
newsitem.headline: Diamond Offshore buys vessel for $81 mln.

text.p: Diamond Offshore Drilling Inc said on Monday it agreed in principle to buy a semisubmersible accommodation vessel for about $81 million cash, financed through a public offering of about 1.25 million common shares.

Accommodation vessels are used to house construction workers building offshore oil or gas production platforms. The veseel to be bought by Diamond accommodates about 800 workers, its chief financial officer, Larry Dickerson, said.
Diamond Offshore said it expected to receive about $15,000 a day under a bareboat charter of the vessel until its present contract expires.
Diamond Offshore said it was negotiating to convert the vessel, known as the Polyconfidence, into a semisubmersible drilling unit at cost of $160 million to $175 million.
The company said it planned to finance the conversion with cash on hand or internal funds.
Diamond Offshore said it will begin to convert the vessel at the end of its present contract, or no later than March 1998.
Diamond Offshore owns 46 mobile offshore drilling rigs, including 30 semisubmersibles, 15 jack-ups and one drillship.
